mode_blocks_description: Place pieces, clear rows and columns.
mode_minefield_description: Sweep a safe channel for the tankers.
mode_convoy_description: Steer your tanker past mines and drones.
mode_merge_description: Merge small boats into giant ships.
mode_shootdown_description: Shoot down waves of drones from the ground.
mode_pipeline_description: Keep the oil flowing while pipes break.
mode_flamingo_description: Flap through the gaps, dive on the refinery.
mode_fury_description: Sling birds at a fortress of blocks.

cameo_xi: Xi Jinping offers {characterName} a replacement strait. Flat-pack, instructions not included.
cameo_zelensky: Zelensky sends a very polite drone to ask whether anyone has tried turning the strait off and on again.
cameo_putin: Putin schedules talks about the strait at a table so long that the far end is in a different time zone.
cameo_merz: Friedrich Merz sets up a working group on {characterName}'s mines. First meeting: next quarter.
cameo_mbs: Mohammed bin Salman offers to buy the whole strait, plus the sea around it, plus the gift shop.
cameo_khamenei: Ali Khamenei closes the strait for a very long tea break. {characterName} was not invited.
cameo_netanyahu: Netanyahu calls an emergency meeting, then a second emergency meeting about the first one.
cameo_erdogan: Erdoğan offers to mediate between {characterName} and the tankers, for a small bridge toll.
cameo_macron: Macron sends {characterName} a strongly worded croissant.
error_lost_body: This page sailed right off the map.
error_broken_body: Only the page got hurt. Try again in a moment.
